Author: Oreo
Name: NoSkippy
Punchline: Slow down dialogue and make cutscene skipping take effort.
Description:
No Skippy stops you spam-clicking through dialogue and makes skipping a cutscene deliberate.

- Dialogue lock: rapid clicking is swallowed until you pause, and new boxes ignore input for a moment so text can be read.
- Skip guard: confirming the skip prompt needs a held key combo (default Ctrl+Shift) with a progress ring, or can be blocked entirely.
- Pause and master-off keybinds, an info bar entry, and chat messages, all rebindable and optional.

Open the settings with /noskippy.
